purpose: Discover a Mochipoyo-independent M5 SHORT edge from all causal M5 decisions without using M7C KERNEL-S1, M10J C0212, M10L candidates, or any forward outcomes as the candidate universe.

candidate_universe.decision_time: new M5 bar open using only the immediately prior fully closed M5 bar and fully closed higher-timeframe context

features.context: latest fully closed M15/H1/H4 causal RCI/MACD/EMA/ATR context

exit_contract.entry: exact M1 open bid at M5 decision time
exit_contract.exit: exact M1 open ask at fixed horizon

decision_policy.robust_pf2: PF >= 2.0 with positive net in 2023-2024, 2025, and 2026 plus fixed-$0.20 all-sample PF > 1.0 and minimum counts
decision_policy.if_no_stable_edge: Do not force M5. Proceed to separately contracted downside-regime SHORT research (M10N).
decision_policy.if_stable_edge_below_pf2: Retain as adoption-direction research candidate and compare with C0212/C056 before regime research.
